mission.goal: Reconstruct a public-safe Secure Capability Box production foundation.
mission.user: EvidenceOps ICT Department and governed Kim DataVerse workloads
mission.workflow: authorize, issue scoped handle, atomically consume, resolve exact secret version, execute one connector action, emit redacted proof
mission.data: secret references, capability claims, metadata-only grants, digests and hash-chained audit events
mission.interface: Python broker, provider and connector contracts
mission.stack: Python 3.11+, SQLite local proof, optional Google Secret Manager and HTTPX adapters
mission.environment: public Federation-Omega source with private runtime bindings excluded
mission.governance: Formation Engine, public repository boundary and least privilege
mission.failure: fail closed with typed, redacted errors
mission.testing: stdlib unit/integration tests, compilation, leak guard and semantic contract validation
mission.deployment: not deployed in Cycle 002; private activation requires a new Formation permit
mission.continuity: operation idempotency, one-time handles, metadata snapshot/restore and AI handoff

assumptions.runtime: isolated service identity with HTTPS egress to approved providers/connectors
assumptions.storage: SQLite is local proof; production topology must be explicitly selected
assumptions.authentication: workload identity plus managed secret/KMS binding

components.database: metadata-only SQLite store with atomic transactions
components.queue: not required for synchronous foundation; production queue must preserve operation IDs
components.storage: managed secret provider plus metadata snapshot
components.authentication: subject/audience-bound signed handle and workload identity

observability.correlation_ids: operation_id is mandatory and propagated to connectors
observability.structured_logs: safe issue events with operation, token and mission IDs
observability.metrics_alerts: production activation must alert on denial, replay, provider and audit failures

testing.unit: token, policy, store, audit and recovery tests
testing.integration: broker-provider-connector and Federation Omega transport contract tests
testing.e2e_or_smoke: local issue-to-receipt path plus readiness assertion
testing.fixtures_mocks: generated token keys, synthetic credential bytes and fake HTTPS transport
testing.failure_first: tamper, expiry, revocation, replay, conflict, concurrency and audit mutation

run_commands: instantiate SecureCapabilityBroker with private provider, connector and policy bindings
deploy_commands: NOT_EXECUTED: obtain a new Formation permit and deploy through the existing Federation Omega pipeline
rollback_commands: disable broker workload identity, revoke outstanding handles, restore prior deployment revision
delivery.debugging: use typed failure class, operation_id, readiness output and verified redacted audit chain; never inspect secret payloads

watchman.policy: deny by default; exact provider, resource prefix, connector, action and minimum authority

continuity.idempotency: operation_id plus canonical redacted request digest
continuity.checkpoints: atomic grant reservation, completion receipt and hash-chained audit
continuity.resume_conditions: new valid handle and matching operation fingerprint, or verified metadata restore
continuity.stop_switch: stop issuance, revoke outstanding handles and disable the broker workload identity

proof.test_results: 17 tests passed locally on 2026-08-02; compilation and repository leak guard passed
proof.semantic_verification: Tests prove scoped issue/execute, denial, expiry, revocation, replay, idempotency, concurrency, zeroization, redaction, audit tamper detection and restore behavior
known_activation_obligations: private policy and Secret Manager resource bindings
threat model, security review and rotation/recovery drills
